verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents TeamViewer's session encryption or its protocol. The first-party items cover pricing, features, SSO, audit logs and validated-account connections, but none of them address encryption. Community comments only ask why end-to-end encryption is missing, which is skepticism rather than concrete evidence either way.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sessions are encrypted end to end with the protocol documented, not just asserted
